title: Thomas Edison
text:
Thomas Edison was a famous inventor from the United States. He was born in 1847 in Ohio. He made many useful things, like the light bulb. Many people still use his ideas today.

Edison did not stop at one invention. He also made a machine that could record sound. It was called the phonograph. He worked in a laboratory in New Jersey, and he often worked late at night.
